issues.reason: A verbless optative wishes its content, it does not state it, so `(Member sk_birthday_1 happy)` at 1.0/0.99 asserts more than the text states — the calibration line's defect test, 'no matter how uncovered the construction is'.

This mistakes a coverage gap for a defect: no head exists for a dedication / sign-off (coining one is barred by 'Never coin a relation head'), and tying the birthday to Laura would itself over-assert — no genitive in the text puts that atom there, so 'point at the words' fails.

gaps_confirmed: verbless optative / formulaic well-wish ('Happy 40th birthday') — no construct records a wish without asserting its content (Directive/Forbid cover commands only, and sealing needs a licensed wrapper)
card/letter framing — a dedication line ('To X') and a sign-off ('Love, X'): no addressee/sender relation for a message exists
new_gaps: `Ordinal`'s scale slot is defined as the associated EVENT or an explicit '-est' dimension, so a recurring anniversary ('40th birthday') has no scale distinct from the entity's own kind — the licensed fit is self-referential
repair_summary: Removed `bday_happy` — the well-wish's content was asserted as fact; with no licensed wrapper for a verbless optative, removal is the only non-inventing fix and the gap is recorded.
notes: The two `Name` atoms are licensed and true (a proper noun gets a name-derived symbol plus exactly one Name fact) and are kept even though nothing else attaches to them; `bday_ordinal` was not raised as an issue and is left untouched.
